qualifier: contractile force, relaxation and hypertrophic growth
name: Cardiac contractility, relaxation and cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth
rationale: All members regulate heart muscle performance (force, rate, relaxation) or cardiomyocyte growth/sarcomere adaptation; unlike confusables it lacks proliferation/regeneration and negative-contraction terms and adds force, relaxation and sarcomere growth.

name: Golgi-endosome membrane trafficking and endosome maturation
rationale: Members cover vesicle budding, tubulation and transport among Golgi, plasma membrane and endosomes; unlike confusables built on Rab/ARF GTPase regulation or Golgi organization, it uniquely has Golgi-to-endosome and early-to-late endosome transport.

core: Polymerase-driven DNA repair and replicative synthesis
qualifier: nucleotide excision repair and translesion synthesis
name: Nucleotide excision repair, translesion and replicative DNA synthesis
rationale: All members concern DNA synthesis by replicative or lesion-bypass polymerases during NER, TLS, replication, telomere C-strand fill-in or hypermutation; NER/UV members separate it from BER-centred confusables and telomere/hypermutation members from the mismatch-repair confusable.

name: Angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
rationale: Members span VEGF/Tie2-driven endothelial sprouting and lymphangiogenesis plus vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and dedifferentiation; the smooth muscle switching set separates it from the angiogenesis-only confusable, and VEGF/endothelial members from the leukocyte-adhesion and aorta confusables.

name: Antibody diversification and antiviral cytidine deamination
rationale: Members concern AID/APOBEC cytidine deamination and editing used for immunoglobulin diversification in developing B cells and for restricting viral genomes; B-cell/hypermutation members separate it from viral-life-cycle confusables, deamination/antiviral members from the class-switch/T-cell confusable.

name: Glial fate specification, proliferation and myelinating differentiation
rationale: All members regulate the birth, proliferation, survival and differentiation of oligodendrocytes, astrocytes and Schwann cells into myelinating glia; glial fate/astrocyte differentiation and myelin maintenance distinguish it from confusables centred on reactive gliosis or axon growth.

core: Cofactor biosynthesis and reactive carbonyl detoxification
name: Vitamin B6/molybdenum cofactor synthesis and methylglyoxal detoxification
rationale: Members split between prosthetic cofactor (PLP, Moco) biosynthesis with Moco-dependent sulfur oxidation and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification with glycation repair of protein and DNA; these cofactor and carbonyl-detox members, not glutathione, ROS or serine, separate it from confusables.

name: Stress- and oncogene-induced senescence with heterochromatin foci
rationale: All members regulate entry into or escape from cell-cycle-arrest senescence; oncogene/oxidative-stress induction and senescence-associated heterochromatin distinguish it from confusables defined by SASP, Polycomb silencing or replicative senescence.

name: PTEN-AKT signalling and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members concern phosphoinositide/inositol phosphate metabolism and PTEN control of PI3K-AKT signalling; inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis separates it from AKT-TSC confusables, and PTEN/AKT members from the PAK-2p34 confusable.

qualifier: myelination, gliosis and axon growth control
name: Axon-glia interactions in myelination, gliosis and axon growth
rationale: Members concern myelin formation and maintenance, glial responses and axonal calibre and growth signalling (p75NTR/ceramide); axonal growth signalling distinguishes it from the glial-development confusable, and myelin/astrocyte members from axon-regeneration confusables.

name: Pancreatic endocrine lineage development and beta-cell insulin secretion
rationale: Members trace pancreatic and neuroendocrine progenitor specification into alpha/beta cells (with adrenal development as the outlier); beta-cell function and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion separate it from confusables centred on bud morphogenesis, ductal cells or incretin processing.

name: Regulation of proteasomal degradation via degrons and K48 ubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate protein stability via N-/C-degron, K48 and autoubiquitination, deubiquitinases and proteasomal catabolism; this native-protein turnover focus separates it from confusables on ribosome quality control, ERAD and aggrephagy.

qualifier: viral translation and host translation control
name: RNA virus genome replication and viral translation control
rationale: Members cover influenza, coronavirus and RSV genome synthesis, RNP assembly and viral/host translation control; RNA-virus replication and translation separate it from retroviral/DNA-virus and from virion entry and assembly confusables.

name: ER-Golgi vesicle targeting with COPI retrograde transport
rationale: All members concern vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi; COPI budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic distinguish it from COPII, tethering and ER protein-insertion confusables.

name: Ephrin and L1 adhesion-mediated axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members are axon guidance and fasciculation cues acting via ephrin, DCC and RAC1; L1 cell-adhesion signalling distinguishes it from SLIT/ROBO and netrin confusables, and ephrin/DCC from the CHL1 pruning confusable.

qualifier: canonical and non-canonical activation with negative regulation
name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB activation and its negative regulation
rationale: Members control IKK/NIK-mediated NF-kappaB activation by TNFR, CD40 and TLR inputs and its restraint; non-canonical and negative-regulation members separate it from TLR-TRAF6/TAK1 and lymphocyte NF-kappaB confusables.

name: CSF1-driven microglia and macrophage proliferation and activation
rationale: Members concern M-CSF signalling and microglial/macrophage differentiation, proliferation, migration and activation; microglia separates it from monocyte/dendritic differentiation confusables and CSF1 signalling from the apoptotic-cell clearance confusable.

name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport
rationale: Members centre on Rh glycoproteins (RHAG, Rh blood group) as ammonium and CO2 membrane channels; Rh/ammonium separates it from erythrocyte gas-exchange and peptide transporter confusables.

name: Synaptic adhesion and glutamate/GABA receptor clustering
rationale: Members concern trans-synaptic adhesion molecules organizing pre- and postsynaptic assembly and clustering AMPA, NMDA and GABA receptors at excitatory and inhibitory synapses; receptor clustering and adhesion families distinguish it from confusables limited to generic synapse assembly regulation.

core: Early embryonic axis and neural patterning
qualifier: dorsoventral axis and neural plate border
name: Dorsoventral axis and neural plate border specification
rationale: Members specify early body axes and regionalize the neural plate, its border and neural crest; neural crest/border and dorsoventral axis members separate it from hindbrain/forebrain, neural fold and limb confusables.

name: p53-induced mitochondrial apoptosis following DNA damage
rationale: Members are p53/DNA-damage induction of BH3-only proteins (PUMA, NOXA) and cytochrome c release; p53/DNA-damage positive regulation separates it from BAD/BIM/BAK/BAX confusables and mitochondrial members from the death-receptor confusables.

name: Protein side-chain methylation and hydroxylation
rationale: Members are lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation of proteins; hydroxylation separates it from histone-methylation and translation confusables, methylation from hypusine/diphthamide confusables.

name: Host-pathogen interaction: bacterial invasion and toxin uptake
rationale: Members are host-microbe interface events (bacterial attachment and entry, toxin uptake, pathogen-triggered NADPH oxidase and anti-inflammatory responses), loosely held together; bacterial entry and toxin uptake distinguish it from Mtb, neutrophil killing and antimicrobial peptide confusables.

qualifier: DNA glycosylase lesion recognition and cleavage
name: DNA glycosylase lesion recognition and base excision initiation
rationale: All members concern glycosylase (NEIL1/3, NTHL1) recognition and removal of damaged bases up to APEX1 handover; this initiation step separates it from confusables on AP-site processing, gap-filling and alkylation reversal.

qualifier: transcriptional control and red cell maturation
name: Transcriptional control of erythroid differentiation and red cell maturation
rationale: Members are erythroid lineage commitment, its transcriptional regulation and terminal red cell membrane maturation (one stress-signalling module aside); erythroid focus separates it from megakaryocyte confusables, and terminal/transcriptional modules from HSC-level confusables.
